evidence.quote: We ratified the async job contract

No blocking
call, and no lost work if the client drops the receipt.

observations.why: Ratification language performs the settling of a contract; the operational 'no blocking call, no lost work' states load-bearing rules the speaker expects others to act on.

evidence.quote:
remember dispatches, then the agent either polls the run or
gets the reaction piggybacked on a later call.

observations.why: Stated as a settled operational rule — the dispatch-and-poll pattern is presented as decided, not argued for; but it restates rather than ratifies, so it sits at decision rather than above.
